items.text: Suitcases to Osaka. First option: Yamato Shimogyo Center (Oe-cho 556, Matsubara, Higashitoin-dori; ~1 km), hold at Yamato Namba Station Center, collect Thu 19 ~18:30. Second option: Japan Post at Yanagibaba-Matsubara Post Office (counter 9:00), hold at Nishinari Tamade Post Office, collect Fri 20. Keep small bags for Yoshino.
Walk north to Nishiki Market (west end, Takakura).
Most probable. Eat at the stall where you buy. Aritsugu knives at the east end.
Most probable, if booked: shared English tour, ~10 min from Nishiki.
Other option for the morning: potter's house, opens 10:00 (open Tuesdays), ~15 min walk from the hotel.
Other option for the morning, instead of K23: Ryōan-ji rock garden (¥600). Taxi from Gojō Karasuma ~9:30; back at Nishiki ~12:00, snacking there instead of lunch.
Lunch near Shijō or Gion, chosen on the spot (snacking at Nishiki can replace it).
Afternoon: Zen garden and the city view
To Kennin-ji, south end of Hanamikoji.
Twin dragons, Wind and Thunder Gods screens, ○△□ garden. ¥800, last entry 16:00. 📿 stamp.
Taxi up the Higashiyama Driveway to Shōgunzuka (no weekday bus).
Deck over the city, Blue Fudō hall, maple garden. ¥600, closes 17:00 (sunset ~16:50 comes after closing).
Taxi back down to Gion (ask reception to call one if none is waiting).
Free gap ~16:30–17:45: snack or rest (the hotel is ~20 min walk).
Meet 17:50 at the Minamiza Theater entrance. Route: Shirakawa (K2a), Tatsumi shrine, Yasaka Shrine, Ryōzen Kannon, Ninenzaka, Hōkan-ji, Yasui Kompira-gū, Hanamikoji (K2b), Ichiriki-tei (K2c).
Dinner in Pontochō, ~10 min west across the river; indoor only in November, last orders vary.
Early night: Wed 18 starts at 5:35 (Fushimi Inari at dawn).
